Our Story

Rooted in Tradition, Made with Love

Grameena Ruchulu — literally "the flavours of the village" — began in a Telangana kitchen with recipes whispered down through generations. What started as jars shared among family became a promise to bring authentic, hand-pounded flavours to homes everywhere.

We still sun-dry our spices, cold-press our sesame oil and cure every batch by hand. No machines, no shortcuts, no preservatives — just the patient craft that real pickle deserves.
